1.consolidated_definition: Atar, sujetar alguien a un animal, sin darle de comer ni de beber durante la noche para que elimine peso, antes de ser vendido.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To fasten or restrain an animal to a person, withholding food and water overnight in order for the animal to lose weight before being sold.
